sn51.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn51.10:1.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
sn51.10:1.4: vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
sn51.10:1.7: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā nisīdanaṃ ādāya bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
sn51.10:2.1: atha kho bhagavā yena cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn51.10:2.2: āyasmāpi kho ānando bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn51.10:2.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn51.10:3.1: ramaṇīyā ānanda, vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sattambaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ.
sn51.10:3.2: yassa kassaci ānanda, ime cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, so ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā.
sn51.10:3.3: tathāgatassa kho ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. ākaṅkhamāno ānanda, tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vāti.
sn51.10:4.1: evampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ.
sn51.10:4.3: “tiṭṭhatu bhante, bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ, bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussāna”nti. yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
sn51.10:5.1: [dutiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca: “ramaṇīyā ānanda, vesālī …pe…
sn51.10:5.2: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
sn51.10:5.3: “ramaṇīyā ānanda, vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sattambaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ.
sn51.10:5.4: yassa kassaci, ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. so ākaṅkhamāno ānanda, kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya, kappāvasesaṃ vā.
sn51.10:5.5: tathāgatassa kho ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. ākaṅkhamāno ānanda, tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vāti.
sn51.10:6.1: evampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ.
sn51.10:6.3: “tiṭṭhatu bhante, bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ, bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussāna”nti. yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.]
sn51.10:7.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi.
sn51.10:7.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
sn51.10:8.1: atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn51.10:9.1: “parinibbātu’dāni bhante, bhagavā, parinibbātu sugato, parinibbānakālo’dāni bhante, bhagavato.
sn51.10:9.2: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante bhagavatā vācā:
sn51.10:9.3: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhū na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desissanti paññāpessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantī”ti.
sn51.10:10.1: santi kho pana bhante, etarahi bhikkhū bhagavato sāvakā viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññāpenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
sn51.10:10.2: parinibbātu’dāni bhante, bhagavā, parinibbātu sugato, parinibbānakālo’dāni bhante, bhagavato.
sn51.10:11.1: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante, bhagavatā vācā:
sn51.10:11.2: “na tāvāhaṃ pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti …pe… yāva me upāsakā na sāvakā bhavissanti …pe… yāva me upāsikā na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā, pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desissanti paññāpessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desissantī”ti.
sn51.10:12.1: santi kho pana bhante, etarahi upāsikā bhagavato sāvikā viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññāpenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
sn51.10:12.2: parinibbātu’dāni bhante, bhagavā, parinibbātu sugato, parinibbānakālo’dāni,
sn51.10:15.1: bhāsitā kho panesā bhante, bhagavatā vācā
sn51.10:15.2: na tāvāhaṃ pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi: yāva me idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na iddhañceva bhavissati phītañca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitanti”.
sn51.10:15.3: nanvidaṃ bhante bhagavato brahmacariyaṃ iddhañceva phītañca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ.
sn51.10:15.4: parinibbātu’dāni bhante, bhagavā, parinibbātu sugato. parinibbānakālo’dāni bhante, bhagavatoti.
sn51.10:16.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etadavoca:
sn51.10:16.2: “appossukko tvaṃ pāpima hohi. na ciraṃ tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
sn51.10:16.3: ito tiṇṇaṃ māsānaṃ accayena tathāgato parinibbāyissatī”ti.
sn51.10:17.1: atha kho bhagavā cāpāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossaji.
sn51.10:17.2: ossaṭṭhe ca bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako lomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu
sn51.10:17.3: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
